400 CR 428 , Paris, MS 38949(Lafayette County)

Size: 78 Acres
Type: Recreational Property, Hunting Property

Lafayette 78

Welcome to the Lafayette 78, located along County Road 428 just east of Paris, Mississippi, in Lafayette County. With a couple of farmland pockets, timber, and plenty of road frontage, this a 78 acre property offers a potential country home site, a gameday getaway, or recreational spot within close proximity to Ole Miss.

As you arrive, you'll notice the old farmland pockets along the south side of County Road 428, which is currently gravel. These would offer potential homesites, providing the opportunity to build a country home or cabin with plenty of privacy and room to spread out. Water and power are not readily available and will require further investigation. It is our understanding that utility service currently extends to within less than a mile east of the property.

The timber make-up is predominately pine timber with some hardwoods scattered about. An established road system meande...

The timber make-up is predominately pine timber with some hardwoods scattered about. An established road system meanders through the tract, leading to a secluded wildlife plot in the timber. There is another wildlife plot in one of the farmland fields with ample room to add a few more throughout the property. Additionally, there are a few seasonal creeks, furthering the wildlife habitat and offering natural water sources and travel corridors. The combination of terrain, timber, natural cover, and available acreage should provide excellent habitat for deer and turkey.

Location is another advantage of the Lafayette 78 being roughly five miles east of Paris, and approximately 15 miles southeast of Oxford, giving you easy access to the restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and amenities of Oxford while still enjoying the privacy and peacefulness of a rural property.

Whether you're looking for a future homesite, a weekend cabin location, or a recreational property with excellent hunting, the Lafayette 78 is worth considering.

Contact Michael Oswalt today to schedule your private tour and experience #TheSmallTownWay!
